t: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世在施特灵城堡的亨利亲王受洗处举行出场仪式.
te: King James VI of Scotland holds a masque at the baptism of Prince Henry at Stirling Castle.
dz: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世在施特灵城堡的亨利亲王受洗处举行出场仪式.
de: King James VI of Scotland holds a masque at the baptism of Prince Henry at Stirling Castle.

dz: 德川家康进入江户城。 （日本传统日期：1590 年 8 月 1 日）
de: Tokugawa Ieyasu enters Edo Castle. (Traditional Japanese date: August 1, 1590)

t: 古鲁·拉姆·达斯成为第四世锡克教古鲁/大师.
te: Guru Ram Das becomes the Fourth Sikh Guru/Master.
dz: 古鲁·拉姆·达斯成为第四世锡克教古鲁/大师.
de: Guru Ram Das becomes the Fourth Sikh Guru/Master.

t: 与教宗公牛"艾乌斯"(Eius qui imimmobilations)一起,教宗保禄三世将英…
te: With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Churc…
dz: 与教宗公牛"艾乌斯"(Eius qui imimmobilations)一起,教宗保禄三世将英格兰国王亨利八世从天主教会中驱逐出,因为批准"苏普雷米西"法案,虽然公牛很可能从未出版.
de: With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Church for approving the Acts of Supremacy, although the bull is likely never published.

t: 保罗二世接任皮乌斯二世为天主教会教宗.
te: Paul II succeeds Pius II as pope of the Catholic Church.
dz: 保罗二世接任皮乌斯二世为天主教会教宗.
de: Paul II succeeds Pius II as pope of the Catholic Church.

t: 5周的宝阳湖之战开始,由中国两名造反派领袖(陈汝g和朱元章)出面,决定由谁来取代元朝.

dz: 5周的宝阳湖之战开始,由中国两名造反派领袖(陈汝g和朱元章)出面,决定由谁来取代元朝.
de: The five-week Battle of Lake Poyang begins, in which the forces of two Chinese rebel leaders (Chen Youliang and Zhu Yuanzhang) meet to decide who will supplant the Yuan dynasty.

t: 阿拉贡的彼得三世从特拉帕尼登陆干预西西里卫斯珀斯人之战.
te: Peter III of Aragon lands at Trapani to intervene in the War of the Sicilian Vespers.
dz: 阿拉贡的彼得三世从特拉帕尼登陆干预西西里卫斯珀斯人之战.
de: Peter III of Aragon lands at Trapani to intervene in the War of the Sicilian Vespers.

dz: 米尔达西德人在al-Funaydiq战役中击败了法蒂米德·哈里发,标志着法蒂米德人最终失去阿勒颇.
de: The Mirdasids defeat the Fatimid Caliphate at the Battle of al-Funaydiq, signalling the definitive loss of Aleppo for the Fatimids.

t: 年长的拜占庭皇帝迈克尔六世·布列纳斯在位仅一年后退位.
te: Elderly Byzantine Emperor Michael VI Bringas abdicates after just one year on the throne.
dz: 年长的拜占庭皇帝迈克尔六世·布列纳斯在位仅一年后退位.
de: Elderly Byzantine Emperor Michael VI Bringas abdicates after just one year on the throne.

te: Titus ends the siege of Jerusalem after destroying Herod's Temple.
dz: 提图斯在摧毁了希律寺后,结束了对耶路撒冷的包围.
de: Titus ends the siege of Jerusalem after destroying Herod's Temple.
